shortDescription: Returns the value of a field in a 1Password item.

options.name: field
options.description: The field label to search for. If the section parameter is undefined, the  field label must be unique across all item fields.

options.name: item
options.description: Name or ID of the item

options.name: section
options.description: An item section label or ID. If provided, the module limits the search for the field to this section. If not provided, the module searches the entire item for the field.

options.name: token
options.description: The token to authenticate 1Password Connect calls. Ansible should never log or display this value.

options.name: vault
options.description: ID of the Vault containing the item
